summary: Iteration 3 backend verification PASSED. 33/33 pytest cases passing (28 prior + 5 new). New behaviors validated end-to-end: (1) /api/daily-content?force=true rate-limit — first force=true returns 200 with joke+fact (live Claude call ~5s), immediate second force=true returns 429 with detail mentioning 'wait', and a cached non-force read still returns 200 within the cooldown window. (2) Rate-limit is per-user — seeded user A is blocked on second force=true while a second seeded user B can force=true at the same moment and gets 200. (3) /api/streak now includes best_streak: zero with no completions, best_streak=5 for runs of 3+gap+5 days, and best_streak=4 with streak=4 when the 4-day run anchor is the last day. All 28 pre-existing tests (auth gating, tasks CRUD, complete/uncomplete, snooze via PATCH, reorder, sort_index, current streak, daily-content cache) still pass.
action_items: No action items — all requested behaviors verified working. (Frontend was out of scope this iteration; the pre-existing 'shadow*' deprecation warning noted in iteration_2 is still present in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/tasks.tsx but is cosmetic.)
critical_code_review_comments: Rate-limit implementation is correct and atomic-enough: server.py:458-475 reads user['last_force_at'], computes elapsed against FORCE_REGEN_COOLDOWN_SEC=60, raises 429 with wait time, then writes new last_force_at BEFORE the LLM call so two near-simultaneous force=true requests from the same user cannot both proceed. ensure_tz_aware() guards naive datetimes coming back from Mongo.
Per-user isolation is correct because last_force_at is stored on the user document keyed by user_id (server.py:472-475). No global state involved.
Cached read path (force=false) is unaffected by last_force_at — verified by test_force_true_rate_limited_per_user step 3.

best_streak computation (server.py:373-385) sorts distinct completion days and scans for the longest consecutive run in O(N log N). Correctly returns 0 on empty set, and 1 for a single isolated day. Independent from current-streak anchor walk, so anchor placement doesn't affect best.
Both new fields (best_streak, last_force_at) are added without breaking the existing response shape — old clients reading {streak, today_completed, date} continue to work.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/conftest.py (added second_seeded_user fixture for per-user isolation tests)
seed_data_creation: Synthetic users + sessions inserted/torn down per-test via seeded_user and new second_seeded_user fixtures. best_streak tests insert completions docs directly into MongoDB (cleaned up in finally blocks). last_force_at is $unset on the user docs before and after each rate-limit test so reruns are deterministic.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py (33 cases). Fixtures in conftest.py: seeded_user, auth_headers, second_seeded_user, mongo_db, base_url, api_client. To exercise force=true cooldown for a user, $unset last_force_at on the user doc first (the fixture itself doesn't reset it). The two rate-limit tests each spend ~5-15s on a real Claude call, so the suite takes ~22s total — keep that in mind for timeouts. Daily-content uses date keys like 2099-XX or 2098-XX/2097-XX to avoid colliding with any cached production rows.
